story.text: I stand here again, what once was a fun activity now made a grueling job with horrible hours.
I work the night shift, I used to find it smart. Making money in the night instead of laying in bed awake.
the sound of all the talking makes me nauseous.
Lets see if today is any better.
i taught working at a bar would help me with being more social.
but i now just feel left out, an outcast at work. the favorite part is when i can work in solitude.
surrounded by drunk guest but no coworkers around me.
annoying guest i can handle, but seeing your colleges despise you always stings.
i get the feeling that as long as i work hard they tolerate me.
its getting very busy, better stop the left loathing and start working.
today is horrible.....
one of the perks of the night shift is that you are allowed to drink a couple of beers.
it always brings me at ease. That fact alone scares me.
i dont wanna become dependent on alcohol.
although...
am i already dependent?
is it already to late?
is this the reason i still put up with this work?
dont think about it.
dont think about it.
dont think about it.
i got work to do.
its to busy to think about this.
better start helping the next guest.
better make the drink.
better clean the bar.
better clean the glasses.
better take another beer to calm the nerves.
help the guest.
make the drink.
take the beer.
clean.
serve.
beer.
ow... its already the end...
time flies when, when.. i am drunk...
how how am i drunk...
i didnt even notice it till the lights came on
it's not that i am the only one.
it's just that i am disappointed in myself.
i am a failure.
we always sit together after a shift.
talk about the day and just catch up.
although i dont have lots to talk about i always sit with them.
the first tram home is in a hour so it helps with killing the time.
[in the corner of my eye i see a mouse walking]
i dont even know of that is a real one or that my sleep deprived mind playing tricks on me.
its fascinating what a mind can do.
it can create its own reality. Show things that are not real.
luckily my mind only does this when i am sleep deprived.
sadly though, i am always sleep deprived.
i dont know why its always mice.
it started years ago and hasn't really gotten worse.
thank god for that i guess.
even tough i am already tipsy i still continue drinking.
i keep trying to stop drinking. i keep saying that today i will stay sober.
and then i just keep on drinking. the feeling that this is my only release haunts me.
i keep having no fallow through.
and so keep disappointing myself.
i need to keep myself together.
i dont wanna cry in front of my colleges.
ah, look at the time. i need to catch the tram.
the cold air stings my skin.
i can feel my tired body slogging along...
everything feels heavy.
when i arrive i see the tram already at the end station.
at least i dont need to wait in the cold.
its completely empty like always. tho i dont complain.
when you are this sleepy even the hardest chairs feel comfy.
i can already feel my eyes closing...
i got to stay up...
